title: Champollion project (project/1)
description: champollion.project.json — the root of a project on the rails. It holds DECISIONS only (what the project is for, its language pair, the defaults new data gets); facts about data live in each file's set/1 sidecar, events in the ledger. Written by `champollion new`; read by every tool. Unknown keys are refused; put your own notes under an `x-` key. A language, task or service project must name its pair (checked by the loader, which says so in words).

kind.description: language = build a translation method for a pair (internal dev); task = host a sealed shared task (a bounty); service = run a translation API; app = translate an app's or site's files.

name.description: A human name for the project.

pair.description: The translation direction. Codes as the language cards name them (ISO 639-3 such as `eng`, `crk`; a private-use code such as `qaa` for a variety without one).

source_name.description: The language's name as the people building this say it. Needed for a private-use code (qaa–qtz), which no language card names; otherwise read from the card.

purpose.description: What the translations are for, in the community's words (e.g. 'school newsletter and classroom phrases'). Shown back to the people deciding, never sent anywhere.

defaults.description: What data added to this project gets when nobody says otherwise. The rails never invent an answer: `ask` makes the tools stop and ask.

transmission.description: local-only = new files are marked so only a model on this machine may see them (the default `champollion new` writes); ask = ask for every file.

training.description: Whether new data may be used to train a model here: allowed, not-allowed, or ask (the default).

share_scores.description: Whether scores may ever be published: never, or ask (the default). Publishing is always an explicit step.

created_with.description: The tool and version that wrote this file (e.g. `champollion 0.6.0`).
